column1: # Data, not code: a provider that turns out to be untrustworthy can be dropped
# through the Phase 20 channel without a release. No provider here is a
# default — ADR 014 preselects the system resolver, because a hardcoded
# default provider transfers the tracking rather than eliminating it.
# INCLUSION IS NOT ENDORSEMENT. The policy column is what the operator
# publishes. This project has not audited any of it and is not well placed to:
# a retention claim is a claim, and the honest thing is to say whose claim it
# is rather than to imply it was checked.
